title: Productivity Empty to Aha
summary: Move a new workspace from blank canvas to first meaningful artifact so retention can start.

strategies.name: Template-led start
strategies.tradeoffs: Fast structure; templates can feel generic or constraining.
strategies.when: Docs, boards, and CRM-like tools with known starting shapes.

strategies.name: Import-existing-work first
strategies.tradeoffs: High switching value; import failures kill trust.

strategies.name: Guided blank canvas with coach marks
strategies.tradeoffs: Feels powerful; higher cognitive load for novices.
strategies.when: Power-user tools where blankness is part of the brand.

strategies.name: AI draft first artifact
strategies.tradeoffs: Instant content; quality variance and trust issues.
strategies.when: Writing, planning, and research products with AI positioning.

forgottenStates: Shared link before object has content
neverDo: Leave a totally blank screen with only a cursor
Force a 12-step tour before first create
Celebrate activation before the user produced anything
evidenceNotes: Compiled from captured app journeys + curated designer wisdom.
